# EnableToolBarItem <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Toolbars](BlitzPlus-Toolbars)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EnableToolBarItem:Void toolbar:Int32, index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `toolbar` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a toolbar. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Number of the icon, counted from 0 and not counting gaps. |

## Description

Turns an icon that was disabled with [DisableToolBarItem](DisableToolBarItem) back on.
